_about: F63 THE WHITE GOOP: the Veteran, gooped (design/story.md 'The Veteran's arc'). From rank 31 one white clump with his squint is in the tank: he never merges or pops (the laser passes through him: 'ow'), oozes BEHIND the goop toward the crack that's hardest for you and slowly seals it. Muzzy's picks from the sketch, 2026-10-25 (research/white-goop/picks.json, sketch research/sketches/white-goop.html). Rules numbers are read by the engine on the rules clock (src/engine/whiteGoop.ts); look numbers by the tank view (src/view/whiteGoopView.ts) on the looks clock. Live in the Dev Kit. Times in seconds, sizes in cells.

_help.fromRank: He's in the tank from this rank on (31: the shift after he's caught at 30).
_help.dropFromCentre: Where he drops in at the start of a shift: this many columns from the middle of the view (negative = left), so he doesn't land under the first piece.
_help.dropSecPerCell: How fast he falls in at the start (seconds per row).
_help.secPerCell: How long he takes to ooze one cell through empty tank.
_help.oozeSlow: How much slower he oozes through a cell with goop in it (2.5 = two and a half times as long).
_help.targetBy: Which crack he goes for: hardestForYou (Muzzy's pick: rows you'd have to build up under it, more if the wrong colour covers it) · oldest · closest.
_help.coveredHardness: hardestForYou: a crack covered by the wrong colour counts as this many rows harder (you'd have to dig it out first).
_help.sealTime: How long he sits on a crack to seal it. Short = a big help; long = a little help. (The sketch: at 6 s he sealed ~26 cracks in 5 minutes on his own.)
_help.sealTimePerExtraCell: Grown cracks (rank 30+, F39): each cell past the first adds this many sealTimes (1 = sealTime × the crack's size; 0.5 = half as much more per cell). He seals the whole crack at once.
_help.restAfter: How long he rests after a seal before heading off again.
_help.thinkSec: With no crack to go to, he looks again this often.
_help.countsForQuota: His seals count toward your crack quota for the shift (true), or only stop the drain (false).
_help.integrityRefund: His seals patch the tank a little, like yours (shift.json integrity.sealRefund).
_help.alpha: How solid he looks in the open (1 = solid).
_help.behindAlpha: How solid he looks while goop covers him (the goop in front goes see-through over him, like a covered crack).
_help.squint: His squint: how far his right eyelid comes down (0 = wide open).
_help.eyeGap: How far apart his eyes sit (cells).
_help.eyeColor: The whites of his eyes (his pupils, rim and brow are the rim colour).
_help.eyesTurnSec: When he drops in at the start of a shift, every goop's eyes turn to him for this long after he lands (story.md rank 31: 'every eye turns to it'). 0 = they don't.
_help.rimColor: The dark rim round his white eyes, so they read on white goop.
_help.owTime: How long the 'ow' bubble stays after the laser goes through him. He flinches and squeezes his eyes shut for the first part.
_help.flinch: How much he squashes when the laser goes through him.
_help.ringWidth: The ring round a crack while he seals it: its line width (cells). It fills as he seals.
_help.ringPad: How far the ring sits outside the crack's cell (cells).
_help.dots: Particle goo style: how many soft dots make up his clump.
